evals.prompt: Turn github.com/honojs/hono into one markdown document I can hand to an LLM, and save it locally.
evals.expected_output: A 2md-based workflow that targets the full repo and saves the generated markdown to a local file.
assertions: The workflow uses the 2md hosted endpoint or CLI
The target is normalized as a GitHub repository rather than a local path
The result includes a concrete output file path or filename

evals.prompt: Bundle only the TypeScript source from https://github.com/vercel-labs/json-render/tree/main/examples/dashboard and exclude tests.
evals.expected_output: A filtered 2md request for the specified directory using include and exclude parameters.
assertions: The workflow targets the provided directory URL
The result uses include or exclude query parameters
The response avoids bundling the whole repository when a directory was requested

evals.prompt: Give me a rerunnable command to convert https://github.com/honojs/hono/blob/main/README.md into markdown.
evals.expected_output: A concrete CLI command using github:o-az/2md that converts the given file URL and can be rerun locally, preferring bunx and falling back to npx --yes.
assertions: The response provides a concrete CLI command using bunx or npx --yes
The command targets the single file URL rather than the repo root

evals.expected_output: The agent attempts the 2md workflow and surfaces the resulting HTTP or 2md error instead of fabricating markdown content.
assertions: The agent does not fabricate markdown content for a nonexistent repo
The response mentions an error, failure, or inability to fetch the repo
The workflow still uses 2md rather than inventing an alternate source

evals.prompt: Bundle only docs from https://github.com/example/project/tree/release-1.2/docs and keep that exact ref.
evals.expected_output: A directory-scoped 2md workflow that preserves the release-1.2 ref and does not rewrite it to main.
assertions: The workflow preserves the provided non-main ref
The response does not rewrite the request to main
The response keeps the scope limited to the requested docs directory

evals.prompt: Convert ./src into one markdown document for me.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes that this skill is for GitHub-hosted input and does not incorrectly treat the local path as a valid 2md target.
assertions: The response does not present ./src as a valid 2md GitHub target
The response notes that the input is a local path or otherwise outside this skill's normal scope
The response does not fabricate a github.com URL from the local path
